name: rac2/ntsc
about: Going Commando, NTSC-U (SCUS_972.68), rac2-decomp: a copy of the function's file with the candidate in place goes through the game's own C chain (the SN cpp, cc1 and as, 32-bit Linux programs in build/compiler/tools) in a container of rac2-decomp's Linux image, with the file's flags from tools/build.py's flags_for (config/cflags.txt). tools/check.py, which only reads src/, is the checker: the candidate is put in the source file for the length of the check and the file restored after.
start: docker start {RAC2_PERMUTER_CONTAINER} >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d --init --platform linux/amd64 --name {RAC2_PERMUTER_CONTAINER} -v {checkout}:{checkout} -v {cache}:{cache} {RAC2_IMAGE} sleep infinity
flags: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'tools'); import build, pathlib; print(build.flags_for(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()))
compile: set -e; cd {tmp}; C={checkout}/build/compiler/tools; $C/cpp -I$C/include -I{checkout}/include -I{srcdir} {spliced} > x.i; $C/cc1 -quiet {flags} x.i -o x.s; $C/as -o {out} x.s
notes: A file whose flags select the SDK compiler (sdk...) or pass -Wa, options is not covered: the base then fails to compile and says so. build/<program>/asm comes from rac2-decomp's own setup.
